name: Access Control
description: Technical policies and procedures must be implemented to allow access only to authorized persons.

name: Audit Logging
description: Hardware, software, and procedural mechanisms must record and examine activity in systems containing ePHI.

name: Data Backup Plan
description: Procedures must be established to create and maintain retrievable exact copies of ePHI.

name: Incident Response
description: Policies and procedures must be implemented to address security incidents affecting ePHI.

name: Data Protection
description: Technical security measures must be implemented to guard against unauthorized access to ePHI transmitted over electronic networks.
